records.topic: Private Property Price and Rental Indices
records.groupTitle: Rental Index Of Residential Properties, (1st Quarter 2009 = 100)
records.title: Rental Index Of Residential Properties, (1st Quarter 2009 = 100), Quarterly
records.footnote: From 1Q 2015, the private residential property rental indices are computed using a stratified hedonic regression method.  Under this method, variations in the attributes of rental private residential properties transacted such as age and unit size are controlled for by using hedonic regressions and rental movements are aggregated using 5-quarter fixed weights to derive the aggregate rental change.  Rental indices are computed from data on rentals provided by the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore.
